accepted_limits: This is a focused inbound RTF to DOCX smoke using a valid RTF input produced by the current DOCX to RTF focused smoke.
The checked-in fixture stores normalized python-docx readback semantics and output sizes rather than committing generated DOCX binaries with environment-specific metadata.

The smoke proves RTF inbound support for one representative document; it does not close LibreOffice-only fallback, WPS application fidelity beyond focused rich roundtrip, comments/fields/revisions/complex layout, or broad old-system binary artifact comparison.
